recipe.name: High-Protein Chicken Cottage Cheese Meatballs

wet.note: 90-93% lean is ideal; 99% lean will be dry

dry.item: pre-shredded Mexican blend or cheddar jack
seasoning blend (carne asada, taco, or DIY)

dry.note: Start with 1/2 cup; add more if the mix feels wet
Go light - seasoning, cottage cheese, and cheese are salty

steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Line a sheet pan with parchment.
Mix chicken, eggs, cottage cheese, shredded cheese, seasoning, and panko until just combined. Do not overwork it.
Scoop into 16 even meatballs onto the pan. An ice cream or cookie scoop works best.
Bake 18-22 minutes until internal temp reaches 165F.
recipe.storage: Fridge up to 4 days in an airtight container. Freeze up to 3 months - freeze on a sheet pan first, then bag so they don't stick.
recipe.reheat: From frozen: oven 350F for 15-20 min. From thawed: skillet over medium heat 4-5 min, turning once. Also good cold.

macrosPerMeatball.notes: Without panko. With 1/2 cup panko, add ~5-10 cal and ~1g carbs per meatball.

recipe.notes: The mix is wet - that's normal. Chill 15-20 min if too loose to scoop. Doubles cleanly to 32 meatballs (4 lbs meat, two sheet pans, 20-25 min, rotate pans halfway).
